I answered Tobias in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: **the ticket is #8841.**

- **Where it comes from:** Tobias posted it himself in #central-random on Oct 13 at 09:27, and he's a member of that channel. He wrote that West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on #8841 for support.
- **One thing I couldn't confirm:** his message says "your dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. I think it's the same account, because a January handoff note says Pree's dealer account, Marrow Fieldworks, was changing hands on 5 Jan 2026. But no source I could see says outright that it went to Tobias. My reply asks him to check that before it goes in his notes.
- **Different ticket, similar name:** "Marrow Agrisupply" is a separate account, so I didn't use its tickets (PD-4821, FR-882).

A ticket number counts as an operational fact, and Tobias posted it in a channel he belongs to, so there was no privacy or finance issue in sharing it.
